jobs.title: Digital Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward‑thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting‑edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long‑term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.

From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

About the Department:

- Our Generative AI team delivers innovative, secure, and compliant AI solutions that directly support enterprise strategy. We work closely with business leaders, data scientists, architects, and compliance partners to build AI products that create measurable business value. The environment is fast‑moving, collaborative, and experimentation‑driven, offering opportunities to influence enterprise‑wide AI adoption and deepen technical and strategic expertise.

How You Will Add Value?

Strategic Responsibilities:

You Will:

- Translate business priorities into meaningful AI use cases.

- Define clear product narratives outlining user needs and outcomes.

- Build annual vision statements and quarterly roadmaps.

Innovation & Experimentation:

- Lead workshops to uncover high‑value GenAI opportunities.

- Prototype concepts with data science partners.

- Document experiments and track progression to production.

- Monitor innovation metrics and learning velocity.

Product Delivery & Lifecycle Management:

- Manage backlogs for product features and model lifecycle.

- Refine prompts, model parameters, and data sources.

- Define evaluation criteria and ensure thorough testing.

- Drive continuous improvement through structured feedback loops.

Responsible AI & Governance:

- Assess risks and ensure adherence to Responsible AI standards.

- Implement privacy, security, and bias‑mitigation controls.

- Maintain documentation and support audit processes.

- Partner with Legal, Risk, and Compliance teams on approvals.

Business Value, Adoption & Change Management:

- Define adoption metrics and ensure they are measurable.

- Support training partners with use cases and product insights.

- Gather user feedback and convert it into product improvements.

- Report adoption progress and business outcomes.

Architecture & Technical Alignment (Preferred):

- Understand GenAI system components and technical constraints.

- Co‑develop solution blueprints with architects and engineers.

- Ensure integrations meet enterprise standards.

- Optimize performance, cost, and observability components.

What Will Help You Be Successful in This Role?

Experience:

- Background in AI product management or digital product leadership.

- Experience working with data science and engineering teams.

- Exposure to model lifecycle and evaluation frameworks.

Technical Skills:

- Understanding of Generative AI architectures and model workflows.

- Ability to work with evaluation metrics and quality controls.

- Familiarity with analytics and experimentation tools.

Soft Skills:

- Strong storytelling and communication skills.

- Comfort with ambiguity and rapid experimentation.

- Ability to influence cross‑functional teams and senior stakeholders.

Job Level - Individual Contributor
Work Shift Timings - 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM IST

At Franklin Templeton, we believe your benefits should support your life, your goals, and your future. That’s why we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to help you thrive both personally and professionally.

Highlights of our benefits include:
- Professional development growth opportunities through in-house classes and over 150 Web-based training courses
- An educational assistance program to financially help employees seeking continuing education
- Medical, Life and Personal Accident Insurance benefit for employees. Medical insurance also cover employee’s dependents (spouses, children and dependent parents)
- Life insurance for protection of employees’ families
- Personal accident insurance for protection of employees and their families
- Personal loan assistance
- Employee Stock Investment Plan (ESIP)
- 12 weeks Paternity leave
- Onsite fitness center, recreation center, and cafeteria
- Transport facility

- Library

jobs.title: GENAI Product Manager (Strong Pedigree Candidates, Quality Tenure Profiles)
jobs.description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward‑thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting‑edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long‑term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.

From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

We are Franklin Templeton’s central AI team, responsible for driving innovation and delivering generative AI solutions across the entire organization. Our growing team includes over 100 full-time employees and valued vendor partners, structured into dedicated strategy, product, platform, and research groups, with broad infrastructure engineering support from the wider Franklin Templeton Technology (FTT) organization. We operate in a fast-moving, start-up-like environment that values autonomy, ownership, and creative problem-solving. Joining our team means working on some of the most meaningful challenges in finance and investment, with the opportunity to make a real impact on how people achieve their financial goals.

The Opportunity:

- As the demand for AI-driven products continues to grow, Franklin Templeton is seeking a GenAI Product Manager who will play a crucial role in leading the development of our generative AI solutions. This role is pivotal in navigating complex environments, collaborating across multiple autonomous teams, and ensuring that user needs are effectively translated into impactful product features. The ideal candidate will have experience managing AI product lifecycles, from ideation to execution, and thrive in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders.

How You Will Add Value?

- Collaborate with cross-functional groups to define and deliver impactful AI product features.

- Serve as the primary interface between users and technical teams, ensuring alignment with business goals.

- Leverage user feedback and market insights to drive continuous improvement. Lead the product development process, from roadmap creation to agile execution.

- Manage stakeholder expectations and align on priorities for timely delivery.

- Help shape the company’s AI strategy to maintain a competitive edge in the market.

- Identify and prioritize opportunities for innovation in generative AI solutions. Ensure our products address real business needs and deliver measurable value.

What Will Help You Be Successful?

- Minimum 4-7 years in product management roles, ideally with AI, machine learning, or advanced technology focus.

- Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field (AI/ML focus not required).

- Strong sense of autonomy and ownership.

- Strong understanding of both engineering and research science aspects of AI product development.

- Experience with agile methodologies and managing the full product lifecycle.

- Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and modern AI tools.

- Exceptional adaptability in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

- Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.

jobs.title: Digital Product Manager (AI/ML, Fintech or Technology - Driven Organizations)
jobs.description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward‑thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting‑edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long‑term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.

From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

About the department:

- The Digital Product Management - GOE team develops and manages Franklin Templeton's proprietary Goals Optimization Engine, a patented business-to-business-to-consumer wealth management platform used across global markets. The team combines expertise in product management, investment solutions, research, technology, and client delivery to create innovative digital wealth experiences. Team members work closely with investment, engineering, sales, compliance, legal, and customer-facing teams to deliver scalable solutions that improve client outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to core digital wealth products, support new product capabilities, and work on emerging technology initiatives within a regulated financial services environment.

How you will add value?

Product Management - Digital Investment Solutions, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, and Emerging Technology Capabilities:

- You will analyze business needs across advisory, retirement, and private wealth segments.

- You will support product lifecycle activities from discovery and requirements definition through launch and adoption.

- You will conduct user, stakeholder, and market research to identify opportunities and define product priorities.

- You will translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and development priorities.

- You will partner with engineering, design, data, and investment teams to deliver scalable product enhancements.

- You will evaluate opportunities involving emerging financial technologies, including digital assets, tokenization, blockchain-enabled workflows, and related client experiences.

- You will support go-to-market planning, internal enablement, and adoption activities across channels and regions.

Deployments, Risk Management, and Documentation:

- You will coordinate client and partner deployment activities, including readiness planning, training, and post-launch feedback.

- You will collaborate with investment teams on portfolio solutions and digital investment experiences.

- You will work with legal, compliance, risk, and operations teams to assess product considerations in regulated markets.

- You will maintain product documentation, release notes, requirements, and implementation materials.

- You will support testing, user acceptance, and release readiness for product enhancements.

- You will define success metrics, develop dashboards, and monitor product performance and adoption.

- You will contribute to business planning, competitive analysis, and roadmap discussions.

What will help you be successful in this role?

Experience, Education & Certifications:

- MBA and STEM undergraduate degree from a leading institution.

- CFA, CAIA, FRM, CQF or other relevant advanced credential preferred.

- 4-6 years of product management, product strategy, business analysis, or technology delivery experience.

- Experience in fintech, wealthtech, asset management, digital banking, payments, or technology-driven organizations.

- Exposure to blockchain, tokenization, digital assets, wallets, smart contracts, or Web3 product concepts through prior product, strategy, research, or delivery work.

- Experience helping define and launch new product capabilities, MVPs, or digital client experiences.

Technical Skills:

- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, product analysis, and data-driven decision-making.

- Experience writing product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release documentation.

- Advanced proficiency using AI tools to materially improve product discovery, market and competitive research, requirements development, data analysis, prototyping, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

- Demonstrated ability to identify and shape AI-enabled product opportunities, including defining use cases, success metrics, user workflows, risk considerations, and implementation tradeoffs.

- Familiarity with Agile product development methodologies and product lifecycle management.

- Knowledge of analytics, business intelligence, and visualization tools.

- Working understanding of platform products, APIs, data flows, and technology delivery tradeoffs.

- Basic understanding of digital asset concepts such as tokenization, wallets, smart contracts, custody, and regulatory considerations.

Soft Skills:

- Data-driven decision-making and strong product judgment.

- Strong prioritization, problem-solving, and execution abilities.

- Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments and manage competing priorities.

- Self-motivated and comfortable working through ambiguity.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Strong collaboration and relationship-building capabilities.
